title: Progressive Rollout Playground
description: Ship a feature to 1% then dial it up. Watch guarded rollouts auto-rollback on error spikes.
longDescription: A hands-on playground for progressive delivery. Start a release at 1% of traffic, monitor the guardrail metrics, and ramp to 100% — or let a guarded rollout auto-revert when errors spike.
